111/**
112 * <p>
113 * Type checks and creates explicit upcast nodes in the AST. When the
114 * expressions are rewritten, the types need to be reanalyzed.
115 * </p>
116 * <pre>
117 * abstract A
118 *     a
119 * abstract B : A
120 *     b
121 * C : B
122 *     c
123 * D : B
124 *     d
125 * </pre>
126 * <p>
127 * A lowest common supertype in this solver directly corresponds to how the
128 * expression is stored as a set. For example, suppose there is an expression
129 * that evaluates to {C0, D0}. Unfortunately, C0 is stored as 0 for the type C
130 * and D0 is also stored as 0 for the type D. The way the solver does it is to
131 * upcast both C0 and D0 to the type B, where C0 = B0 and D0 = B1 so the set
132 * {C0, D0} can be stored as {B0, B1}, ie. {0, 1} in Choco.
133 * {@link Type#getCommonSupertype()} of each expression is the type used for
134 * representing the set in Choco.
135 * </p>
136 * <p>
137 * Even though the expressions are stored as the common supertype, it is
138 * sometimes necessary to reconvert it back to the subtype. For example,
139 * consider the expression {@code (C ++ D).d}. {@code (C ++ D)} has the union
140 * type {C, D} but is stored as the supertype B. The join {@code .d} is allowed
141 * because D is in the union type of {@code (C ++ D)}, but since it is stored as
142 * a set of B's, the set first needs to be downcasted to a set of D's before the
143 * join can be performed. If the expression were {@code (C ++ D).a}, then the
144 * set of B's would need to be upcasted to a set of A's. If the expression were
145 * {@code (C ++ D).b} then no casting is required.
146 * </p>
147 *
148 * @author jimmy
149 */
150public class TypeAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
151
152    @Override
153    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
154        Map<AstExpr, Type> typeMap = new IdentityHashMap<>();
155        Scope scope = analysis.getScope();
156        Map<AstConstraint, AstBoolExpr> typedConstraints = new HashMap<>();
157        for (AstConstraint constraint : analysis.getConstraints()) {
158            AstClafer clafer = constraint.getContext();
159            TypeVisitor visitor = new TypeVisitor(Type.basicType(clafer), typeMap, scope);
160            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> typedConstraint = at(constraint.getSpan(),
161                    () -> visitor.typeCheck(analysis.getExpr(constraint)));
162            typedConstraints.put(constraint, typedConstraint.getExpr());
163        }
164        Map<Objective, AstSetExpr> objectives = analysis.getObjectiveExprs();
165        Map<Objective, AstSetExpr> typedObjectives = new HashMap<>(objectives.size());
166        for (Entry<Objective, AstSetExpr> objective : objectives.entrySet()) {
167            TypeVisitor visitor = new TypeVisitor(Type.basicType(analysis.getModel().getAbstractRoot()), typeMap, scope);
168            SourceSpan span = objective.getKey().getSpan();
169            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> typedObjective = at(span, () -> visitor.typeCheck(objective.getValue()));
170            // A decimal objective optimizes the scaled decimal.
171            if (!typedObjective.getCommonSupertype().isInt() && !typedObjective.getCommonSupertype().isDecimal()) {
172                throw new TypeException(at(span, "Cannot optimize on " + typedObjective.getType()));
173            }
174            typedObjectives.put(objective.getKey(), typedObjective.getExpr());
175        }
176        Map<Assertion, AstBoolExpr> assertions = analysis.getAssertionExprs();
177        Map<Assertion, AstBoolExpr> typedAssertions = new HashMap<>(assertions.size());
178        for (Entry<Assertion, AstBoolExpr> assertion : assertions.entrySet()) {
179            TypeVisitor visitor = new TypeVisitor(Type.basicType(analysis.getModel().getAbstractRoot()), typeMap, scope);
180            SourceSpan span = assertion.getKey().getSpan();
181            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> typedAssertion = at(span, () -> visitor.typeCheck(assertion.getValue()));
182            if (!typedAssertion.getCommonSupertype().isBool()) {
183                throw new TypeException(at(span, "Cannot assert on " + typedAssertion.getType()));
184            }
185            typedAssertions.put(assertion.getKey(), typedAssertion.getExpr());
186        }
187        return analysis.setTypeMap(typeMap)
188                .setConstraintExprs(typedConstraints)
189                .setObjectiveExprs(typedObjectives)
190                .setAssertionExprs(typedAssertions);
191    }
192
193    private static String at(SourceSpan span, String message) {
194        return span == null ? message : span.format(message);
195    }
196
197    /**
198     * Type checks, prefixing a type error with the source position.
199     */
200    private static <T> T at(SourceSpan span, Supplier<T> typeCheck) {
201        try {
202            return typeCheck.get();
203        } catch (TypeException e) {
204            if (span == null) {
205                throw e;
206            }
207            throw new TypeException(span.format(e.getMessage()), e);
208        }
209    }
210
211    private static class TypeVisitor {
212
213        private final Type context;
214        private final Map<AstExpr, Type> typeMap;
215        private final Scope scope;
216
217        TypeVisitor(Type context, Map<AstExpr, Type> typeMap, Scope scope) {
218            this.context = context;
219            this.typeMap = typeMap;
220            this.scope = scope;
221        }
222
223        private static boolean isNumber(TypedExpr<?> expr) {
224            return expr.getType().isInt() || expr.getType().isDecimal();
225        }
226
227        private static boolean isDecimal(TypedExpr<?> expr) {
228            return expr.getType().isDecimal();
229        }
230
231        /**
232         * @return whether one expression is an integer and the other a decimal
233         */
234        private static boolean isMixedNumber(TypedExpr<?> left, TypedExpr<?> right) {
235            return isNumber(left) && isNumber(right) && isDecimal(left) != isDecimal(right);
236        }
237
238        /**
239         * The integer as a decimal: integer constants are scaled, other
240         * integer expressions are multiplied by the decimal 1, which is exact.
241         * Decimals stay as they are, so the lowering is the same when the
242         * types are reanalyzed.
243         *
244         * @param expr an integer or a decimal
245         * @return the decimal
246         */
247        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> toDecimal(TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> expr) {
248            if (isDecimal(expr)) {
249                return expr;
250            }
251            if (!expr.getType().isInt()) {
252                throw new TypeException("Cannot convert " + expr.getType() + " to decimal");
253            }
254            if (expr.getExpr() instanceof AstConstant) {
255                int[][] value = ((AstConstant) expr.getExpr()).value();
256                if (value.length == 1) {
257                    int[] scaled = new int[value[0].length];
258                    for (int i = 0; i < scaled.length; i++) {
259                        scaled[i] = scaleInt(value[0][i]);
260                    }
261                    return put(DecimalType, (AstSetExpr) constant(DecimalType, scaled));
262                }
263            }
264            AstConstant decimalOne = constant(DecimalType, scope.getDecimalOne());
265            put(DecimalType, decimalOne);
266            return put(DecimalType, arithm(AstArithm.Op.Mul, expr.getExpr(), decimalOne));
267        }
268
269        private int scaleInt(int value) {
270            long scaled = (long) value * scope.getDecimalOne();
271            if (Math.abs(scaled) > Scope.MaxScaledDecimal) {
272                throw new TypeException(value + " is out of the range of decimals with "
273                        + scope.getDecimalScale() + " fractional digits");
274            }
275            return (int) scaled;
276        }
277
278        @SafeVarargs
279        private final AstSetExpr[] toDecimals(TypedExpr<AstSetExpr>... exprs) {
280            AstSetExpr[] decimals = new AstSetExpr[exprs.length];
281            for (int i = 0; i < exprs.length; i++) {
282                decimals[i] = toDecimal(exprs[i]).getExpr();
283            }
284            return decimals;
285        }
286
287        private <T extends AstExpr> TypedExpr<T> typeCheck(T expr) {
288            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
289            TypedExpr<T> typedExpr = (TypedExpr<T>) switch (expr) {
290                case AstArithm e -> visit(e);
291                case AstBoolArithm e -> visit(e);
292                case AstCard e -> visit(e);
293                case AstChildRelation e -> visit(e);
294                case AstCompare e -> visit(e);
295                case AstConcat e -> visit(e);
296                case AstConnected e -> visit(e);
297                case AstConstant e -> visit(e);
298                case AstDecimalConstant e -> visit(e);
299                case AstDifference e -> visit(e);
300                case AstDomainRestriction e -> visit(e);
301                case AstDowncast e -> visit(e);
302                case AstGlobal e -> visit(e);
303                case AstIfThenElse e -> visit(e);
304                case AstIntersection e -> visit(e);
305                case AstInverse e -> visit(e);
306                case AstJoin e -> visit(e);
307                case AstJoinParent e -> visit(e);
308                case AstJoinRef e -> visit(e);
309                case AstLength e -> visit(e);
310                case AstLocal e -> visit(e);
311                case AstMax e -> visit(e);
312                case AstMembership e -> visit(e);
313                case AstMin e -> visit(e);
314                case AstMinus e -> visit(e);
315                case AstMod e -> visit(e);
316                case AstNot e -> visit(e);
317                case AstParentRelation e -> visit(e);
318                case AstPrefix e -> visit(e);
319                case AstProduct e -> visit(e);
320                case AstQuantify e -> visit(e);
321                case AstRangeRestriction e -> visit(e);
322                case AstRefRelation e -> visit(e);
323                case AstSetTest e -> visit(e);
324                case AstStringConstant e -> visit(e);
325                case AstSuffix e -> visit(e);
326                case AstSum e -> visit(e);
327                case AstTernary e -> visit(e);
328                case AstThis e -> visit(e);
329                case AstTransitiveClosure e -> visit(e);
330                case AstUnion e -> visit(e);
331                case AstUpcast e -> visit(e);
332            };
333            return typedExpr;
334        }
335
336        private <T extends AstExpr> TypedExpr<T>[] typeCheck(T[] exprs) {
337            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
338            TypedExpr<T>[] typeChecked = (TypedExpr<T>[]) new TypedExpr<?>[exprs.length];
339            for (int i = 0; i < exprs.length; i++) {
340                typeChecked[i] = typeCheck(exprs[i]);
341            }
342            return typeChecked;
343        }
344
345        /**
346         * Multilevel cast.
347         *
348         * @param expr the expression
349         * @param target the target type
350         * @return the same expression but with the target type
351         */
352        private AstSetExpr castTo(TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> expr, ProductType target) {
353            if (isAssignable(expr.getCommonSupertype(), target)) {
354                return upcastTo(expr, target);
355            } else if (isAnyAssignable(expr.getUnionType(), target)) {
356                return downcastTo(expr, target);
357            }
358            throw new TypeException("Cannot cast " + expr.getType() + " to " + target);
359        }
360
361        /**
362         * Multilevel cast.
363         *
364         * @param expr the expression
365         * @param target the target type
366         * @return the same expression but with the target type
367         */
368        private AstSetExpr castTo(TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> expr, AstClafer target) {
369            return castTo(expr, new ProductType(target));
370        }
371
372        /**
373         * Multilevel downcast.
374         *
375         * @param expr the expression
376         * @param target the target type
377         * @return the same expression but with the target type
378         */
379        private AstSetExpr downcastTo(TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> expr, ProductType target) {
380            if (expr.getType().getCommonSupertype().equals(target)) {
381                return expr.getExpr();
382            }
383            if (isAnyAssignable(target, expr.getUnionType())) {
384                AstSetExpr subExpr = downcast(expr.getExpr(), target);
385                put(new Type(target), subExpr);
386                return subExpr;
387            }
388            throw new TypeException("Cannot downcast " + expr.getType() + " to " + target);
389        }
390
391        /**
392         * Multilevel upcast.
393         *
394         * @param expr the expression
395         * @param target the target type
396         * @return the same expression but with the target type
397         */
398        private AstSetExpr upcastTo(TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> expr, ProductType target) {
399            if (expr.getType().getCommonSupertype().equals(target)) {
400                return expr.getExpr();
401            }
402            if (isAssignable(expr.getCommonSupertype(), target)) {
403                AstSetExpr superExpr = upcast(expr.getExpr(), target);
404                put(new Type(target), superExpr);
405                return superExpr;
406            }
407            throw new TypeException("Cannot upcast " + expr.getType() + " to " + target);
408        }
409
410        private <T extends AstExpr> TypedExpr<T> put(AstClafer basicType, T expr) {
411            return put(Type.basicType(basicType), expr);
412        }
413
414        private <T extends AstExpr> TypedExpr<T> put(AstClafer paramType, AstClafer returnType, T expr) {
415            return put(new Type(new ProductType(paramType, returnType)), expr);
416        }
417
418        private <T extends AstExpr> TypedExpr<T> put(ProductType type, T expr) {
419            return put(new Type(type), expr);
420        }
421
422        private <T extends AstExpr> TypedExpr<T> put(Type type, T expr) {
423            typeMap.put(expr, type);
424            return new TypedExpr<>(type, expr);
425        }
426
427        private TypedExpr<AstThis> visit(AstThis ast) {
428            return put(context, ast);
429        }
430
431        private TypedExpr<AstGlobal> visit(AstGlobal ast) {
432            return put(Type.basicType(ast.type()), ast);
433        }
434
435        private TypedExpr<AstConstant> visit(AstConstant ast) {
436            return put(new Type(ast.type()), ast);
437        }
438
439        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstStringConstant ast) {
440            return put(Type.basicType(AstStringClafer.Singleton), ast);
441        }
442
443        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstDecimalConstant ast) {
444            int scaled;
445            try {
446                scaled = scope.scaleDecimal(ast.value(), RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY);
447            } catch (ArithmeticException e) {
448                throw new TypeException(ast + " has more fractional digits than the decimal scale "
449                        + scope.getDecimalScale());
450            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
451                throw new TypeException(e.getMessage());
452            }
453            return put(DecimalType, constant(DecimalType, scaled));
454        }
455
456        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstJoin ast) {
457            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> left = typeCheck(ast.left());
458            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> right = typeCheck(ast.right());
459            if (right.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2) {
460                AstClafer rightParamType = right.getCommonSupertype().get(0);
461                AstClafer rightReturnType = right.getCommonSupertype().get(1);
462                switch (left.getType().getCommonSupertype().arity()) {
463                    case 1:
464                        if (isAnyAssignable(left.getType().getUnionType(), rightParamType)) {
465                            return put(rightReturnType, join(castTo(left, rightParamType), right.getExpr()));
466                        }
467                        break;
468                    case 2:
469                        AstClafer leftParamType = left.getCommonSupertype().get(0);
470                        AstClafer leftReturnType = left.getCommonSupertype().get(1);
471                        if (leftReturnType.equals(rightParamType)) {
472                            return put(leftParamType, rightReturnType, join(left.getExpr(), right.getExpr()));
473                        }
474                        break;
475                }
476            }
477            throw new TypeException("Cannot join " + left.getType() + " . " + right.getType());
478        }
479
480        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstJoinParent ast) {
481            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> children = typeCheck(ast.children());
482            if (children.getType().isClaferType()) {
483                AstClafer childrenType = children.getType().getClaferType();
484                if (!AstUtil.isTop(childrenType) && !AstUtil.isTypeRoot(childrenType)) {
485                    return put(childrenType.getParent(), joinParent(children.getExpr()));
486                }
487                // A top-level abstract Clafer has no parent of its own: the parents of
488                // its instances are those of its subclafers, e.g., for
489                //     abstract Feature
490                //         [ parent in Feature, FeatureModel ]
491                // the parent of a Feature is the union of the parents of the Feature
492                // instances of each subclafer.
493                if (childrenType instanceof AstAbstractClafer
494                        && !((AstAbstractClafer) childrenType).getSubs().isEmpty()) {
495                    AstSetExpr parents = null;
496                    for (AstClafer sub : ((AstAbstractClafer) childrenType).getSubs()) {
497                        if (sub instanceof AstConcreteClafer && AstUtil.isTop(sub)) {
498                            throw new TypeException("Cannot join " + children.getType()
499                                    + " . parent: its subclafer " + sub + " is a top-level clafer");
500                        }
501                        AstSetExpr subParents = joinParent(downcast(ast.children(), new ProductType(sub)));
502                        parents = parents == null ? subParents : union(parents, subParents);
503                    }
504                    return typeCheck(parents);
505                }
506            }
507            throw new TypeException("Cannot join " + children.getType() + " . parent");
508        }
509
510        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstJoinRef ast) {
511            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> deref = typeCheck(ast.deref());
512
513            Set<AstRef> refs = new HashSet<>();
514            for (ProductType type : deref.getUnionType()) {
515                if (!type.isClaferType()) {
516                    throw new TypeException("Cannot join " + deref.getType() + " . ref");
517                }
518                AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(type.getClaferType());
519                if (ref != null) {
520                    refs.add(ref);
521                }
522            }
523            switch (refs.size()) {
524                case 0:
525                    throw new TypeException("Cannot join " + deref.getType() + " . ref");
526                case 1:
527                    AstRef ref = refs.iterator().next();
528                    return put(ref.getTargetType(), joinRef(castTo(deref, ref.getSourceType())));
529                default:
530                    throw new TypeException("Ambiguous join " + deref.getType() + " . ref");
531            }
532        }
533
534        private TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> visit(AstNot ast) {
535            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> expr = typeCheck(ast.expr());
536            return put(BoolType, not(expr.getExpr()));
537        }
538
539        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstMinus ast) {
540            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> expr = typeCheck(ast.expr());
541            if (expr.getType().isInt()) {
542                return put(IntType, minus(expr.getExpr()));
543            }
544            if (expr.getType().isDecimal()) {
545                return put(DecimalType, minus(expr.getExpr()));
546            }
547            throw new TypeException("Cannot -" + expr.getType());
548        }
549
550        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstCard ast) {
551            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> set = typeCheck(ast.set());
552            if (set.getType().isPrimitive()) {
553                throw new TypeException("Cannot |" + set.getType() + "|");
554            }
555            return put(IntType, card(set.getExpr()));
556        }
557
558        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstMax ast) {
559            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> set = typeCheck(ast.set());
560            if (set.getType().isInt()) {
561                return put(IntType, max(set.getExpr()));
562            }
563            if (set.getType().isDecimal()) {
564                return put(DecimalType, max(set.getExpr()));
565            }
566            throw new TypeException("Cannot max " + set.getType() + "|");
567        }
568
569        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstMin ast) {
570            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> set = typeCheck(ast.set());
571            if (set.getType().isInt()) {
572                return put(IntType, min(set.getExpr()));
573            }
574            if (set.getType().isDecimal()) {
575                return put(DecimalType, min(set.getExpr()));
576            }
577            throw new TypeException("Cannot min " + set.getType() + "|");
578        }
579
580        private TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> visit(AstSetTest ast) {
581            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> left = typeCheck(ast.left());
582            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> right = typeCheck(ast.right());
583            if (isMixedNumber(left, right)) {
584                left = toDecimal(left);
585                right = toDecimal(right);
586            }
587
588            if (isDisjoint(left.getType(), right.getType())) {
589                throw new TypeException("Cannot " + left.getType() + " "
590                        + ast.op().getSyntax() + " " + right.getType());
591            }
592
593            ProductType commonType = getLowestCommonSupertype(left.getCommonSupertype(), right.getCommonSupertype());
594            return put(BoolType, test(upcastTo(left, commonType), ast.op(), upcastTo(right, commonType)));
595        }
596
597        private TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> visit(AstCompare ast) {
598            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> left = typeCheck(ast.left());
599            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> right = typeCheck(ast.right());
600            if (left.getType().isInt() && right.getType().isInt()) {
601                return put(BoolType, compare(left.getExpr(), ast.op(), right.getExpr()));
602            }
603            if (isNumber(left) && isNumber(right)) {
604                return put(BoolType, compare(toDecimal(left).getExpr(), ast.op(), toDecimal(right).getExpr()));
605            }
606            throw new TypeException("Cannot " + left.getType() + " "
607                    + ast.op().getSyntax() + " " + right.getType());
608        }
609
610        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstArithm ast) {
611            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr>[] operands = typeCheck(ast.operands());
612            boolean decimal = false;
613            for (TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> operand : operands) {
614                if (!isNumber(operand)) {
615                    throw new TypeException("Cannot "
616                            + Util.intercalate(" " + ast.op().getSyntax() + " ",
617                                    getTypes(operands)));
618                }
619                decimal |= isDecimal(operand);
620            }
621            switch (ast.op()) {
622                case DecimalMul:
623                case DecimalDiv:
624                    return put(DecimalType, arithm(ast.op(), toDecimals(operands)));
625                default:
626                    if (!decimal) {
627                        return put(IntType, arithm(ast.op(), getSetExprs(operands)));
628                    }
629            }
630            switch (ast.op()) {
631                case Add:
632                case Sub:
633                    return put(DecimalType, arithm(ast.op(), toDecimals(operands)));
634                case Mul:
635                    // A decimal times an integer is exact; a decimal times a
636                    // decimal is rounded to the decimal scale.
637                    TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> product = operands[0];
638                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
639                        TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> operand = operands[i];
640                        if (isDecimal(product) && isDecimal(operand)) {
641                            product = put(DecimalType, arithm(AstArithm.Op.DecimalMul,
642                                    product.getExpr(), operand.getExpr()));
643                        } else {
644                            product = put(isDecimal(product) || isDecimal(operand) ? DecimalType : IntType,
645                                    arithm(AstArithm.Op.Mul, product.getExpr(), operand.getExpr()));
646                        }
647                    }
648                    return product;
649                case Div:
650                    // A division of integers stays an integer division.
651                    TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> quotient = operands[0];
652                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
653                        TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> operand = operands[i];
654                        if (isDecimal(quotient) || isDecimal(operand)) {
655                            quotient = put(DecimalType, arithm(AstArithm.Op.DecimalDiv,
656                                    toDecimals(quotient, operand)));
657                        } else {
658                            quotient = put(IntType, arithm(AstArithm.Op.Div,
659                                    quotient.getExpr(), operand.getExpr()));
660                        }
661                    }
662                    return quotient;
663                default:
664                    throw new TypeException("Cannot "
665                            + Util.intercalate(" " + ast.op().getSyntax() + " ",
666                                    getTypes(operands)));
667            }
668        }
669
670        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstMod ast) {
671            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> dividend = typeCheck(ast.dividend());
672            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> divisor = typeCheck(ast.divisor());
673            if (dividend.getType().isInt() && divisor.getType().isInt()) {
674                return put(IntType, mod(dividend.getExpr(), divisor.getExpr()));
675            }
676            if (isNumber(dividend) && isNumber(divisor)) {
677                // The remainder of decimals at the same scale is exact.
678                return put(DecimalType, mod(toDecimal(dividend).getExpr(), toDecimal(divisor).getExpr()));
679            }
680            throw new TypeException("Cannot " + dividend.getType() + " % " + divisor.getType());
681        }
682
683        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstSum ast) {
684            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> set = typeCheck(ast.set());
685
686            Set<AstRef> refs = new HashSet<>();
687            for (ProductType product : set.getType()) {
688                if (!product.isClaferType()) {
689                    throw new TypeException("Cannot sum(" + set.getType() + ")");
690                }
691                AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(product.getClaferType());
692                if (ref != null) {
693                    refs.add(ref);
694                }
695            }
696            switch (refs.size()) {
697                case 0:
698                    throw new TypeException("Cannot sum(" + set.getType() + ")");
699                case 1:
700                    AstRef ref = refs.iterator().next();
701                    if (ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstIntClafer
702                            || ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstDecimalClafer) {
703                        return put(ref.getTargetType(), sum(castTo(set, ref.getSourceType())));
704                    }
705                    throw new TypeException("Cannot sum(" + set.getType() + ")");
706                default:
707                    throw new TypeException("Ambiguous sum(" + set.getType() + ")");
708            }
709        }
710
711        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstProduct ast) {
712            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> set = typeCheck(ast.set());
713
714            Set<AstRef> refs = new HashSet<>();
715            for (ProductType product : set.getType()) {
716                if (!product.isClaferType()) {
717                    throw new TypeException("Cannot product(" + set.getType() + ")");
718                }
719                AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(product.getClaferType());
720                if (ref != null) {
721                    refs.add(ref);
722                }
723            }
724            switch (refs.size()) {
725                case 0:
726                    throw new TypeException("Cannot product(" + set.getType() + ")");
727                case 1:
728                    AstRef ref = refs.iterator().next();
729                    if (ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstIntClafer) {
730                        return put(ref.getTargetType(), product(castTo(set, ref.getSourceType())));
731                    }
732                    // A product of decimals would round after each factor.
733                    throw new TypeException("Cannot product(" + set.getType() + ")");
734                default:
735                    throw new TypeException("Ambiguous product(" + set.getType() + ")");
736            }
737        }

739        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstBoolArithm ast) {
740            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr>[] operands = typeCheck(ast.operands());
741            return put(BoolType, arithm(ast.op(), getBoolExprs(operands)));
742        }

744        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstDifference ast) {
745            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> left = typeCheck(ast.left());
746            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> right = typeCheck(ast.right());
747            if (isMixedNumber(left, right)) {
748                left = toDecimal(left);
749                right = toDecimal(right);
750            }
751
752            if (!isAssignable(right.getType(), left.getType())) {
753                throw new TypeException("Cannot " + left.getType() + " -- " + right.getType());
754            }
755
756            // TODO: check for primitives
757            return put(left.getType(), diff(
758                    left.getExpr(),
759                    castTo(right, left.getCommonSupertype())));
760        }

762        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstIntersection ast) {
763            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> left = typeCheck(ast.left());
764            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> right = typeCheck(ast.right());
765            if (isMixedNumber(left, right)) {
766                left = toDecimal(left);
767                right = toDecimal(right);
768            }
769
770            Type intersectionType = intersectionType(left.getType(), right.getType());
771
772            // TODO: check for primitives
773            return put(intersectionType, inter(
774                    downcastTo(left, intersectionType.getCommonSupertype()),
775                    downcastTo(right, intersectionType.getCommonSupertype())));
776        }

778        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstUnion ast) {
779            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> left = typeCheck(ast.left());
780            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> right = typeCheck(ast.right());
781            if (isMixedNumber(left, right)) {
782                left = toDecimal(left);
783                right = toDecimal(right);
784            }
785
786            Type unionType = unionType(left.getType(), right.getType());
787
788            if (unionType.getCommonSupertype() == null) {
789                throw new TypeException("Cannot " + left.getType() + " ++ " + right.getType());
790            }
791            return put(unionType, union(
792                    upcastTo(left, unionType.getCommonSupertype()),
793                    upcastTo(right, unionType.getCommonSupertype())));
794        }

796        private TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> visit(AstMembership ast) {
797            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> member = typeCheck(ast.member());
798            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> set = typeCheck(ast.set());
799            if (isMixedNumber(member, set)) {
800                member = toDecimal(member);
801                set = toDecimal(set);
802            }
803
804            if (isDisjoint(member.getType(), set.getType())) {
805                throw new TypeException("Cannot " + member.getType()
806                        + " " + ast.op().getSyntax() + " " + set.getType());
807            }
808
809            ProductType commonType = getLowestCommonSupertype(member.getCommonSupertype(), set.getCommonSupertype());
810            return put(BoolType, membership(upcastTo(member, commonType), ast.op(), upcastTo(set, commonType)));
811        }

813        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstTernary ast) {
814            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> antecedent = typeCheck(ast.antecedent());
815            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> alternative = typeCheck(ast.alternative());
816            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> consequent = typeCheck(ast.consequent());
817            if (isMixedNumber(alternative, consequent)) {
818                alternative = toDecimal(alternative);
819                consequent = toDecimal(consequent);
820            }
821            ProductType unionType = getLowestCommonSupertype(alternative.getCommonSupertype(), consequent.getCommonSupertype());
822            return put(new Type(unionType), ifThenElse(antecedent.getExpr(),
823                    upcastTo(consequent, unionType), upcastTo(alternative, unionType)));
824        }

826        private TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> visit(AstIfThenElse ast) {
827            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> antecedent = typeCheck(ast.antecedent());
828            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> alternative = typeCheck(ast.alternative());
829            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> consequent = typeCheck(ast.consequent());
830            return put(BoolType, ifThenElse(antecedent.getExpr(), consequent.getExpr(), alternative.getExpr()));
831        }

833        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstDowncast ast) {
834            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> base = typeCheck(ast.base());
835            ProductType to = ast.target();
836            if (isAnyAssignable(to, base.getUnionType())) {
837                return put(new Type(to), downcast(base.getExpr(), to));
838            }
839            throw new TypeException("Cannot downcast from " + base.getType() + " to " + to);
840        }

842        private TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> visit(AstUpcast ast) {
843            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> base = typeCheck(ast.base());
844            ProductType to = ast.target();
845            if (isAssignable(base.getCommonSupertype(), to)) {
846                return put(new Type(base.getUnionType(), to), upcast(base.getExpr(), to));
847            }
848            throw new TypeException("Cannot upcast from " + base.getType() + " to " + to);

851        private TypedExpr<AstLocal> visit(AstLocal ast) {
852            Type localType = typeMap.get(ast);
853            if (localType == null) {
854                throw new AnalysisException(ast + " type not analyzed yet.");
855            }

859        private TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> visit(AstQuantify ast) {
860            AstDecl[] decls = new AstDecl[ast.decls().length];
861            for (int i = 0; i < ast.decls().length; i++) {
862                AstDecl decl = ast.decls()[i];
863                TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> body = typeCheck(decl.getBody());
864                for (AstLocal local : decl.getLocals()) {
865                    put(body.getType(), local);
866                }
867                decls[i] = decl(decl.isDisjoint(), decl.getLocals(), body.getExpr());
868            }
869            TypedExpr<AstBoolExpr> body = typeCheck(ast.body());
870            return put(BoolType, quantify(ast.quantifier(), decls, body.getExpr()));
871        }

908        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstChildRelation ast) {

912            }

929        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstDomainRestriction ast) {
930            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> domain = typeCheck(ast.domain());
931            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> relation = typeCheck(ast.relation());
932            if (relation.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2
933                    && !isDisjoint(Type.basicType(relation.getCommonSupertype().get(0)), domain.getType())) {
934                return put(relation.getType(), domainRestriction(domain.getExpr(), relation.getExpr()));
935            }
936            throw new TypeException(relation + " cannot " + domain.getType() + " <: " + relation.getType());
937        }

939        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstRangeRestriction ast) {
940            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> relation = typeCheck(ast.relation());
941            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> range = typeCheck(ast.range());
942            if (relation.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2
943                    && !isDisjoint(Type.basicType(relation.getCommonSupertype().get(1)), range.getType())) {
944                return put(relation.getType(), rangeRestriction(relation.getExpr(), range.getExpr()));
945            }
946            throw new TypeException(relation + " cannot " + relation.getType() + " :> " + range.getType());
947        }

949        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstInverse ast) {
950            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> relation = typeCheck(ast.relation());
951            if (relation.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2) {
952                AstClafer paramType = relation.getCommonSupertype().get(0);
953                AstClafer returnType = relation.getCommonSupertype().get(1);
954                return put(returnType, paramType, inverse(relation.getExpr()));
955            }
956            throw new TypeException(relation + " cannot be inversed");
957        }
958
959        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstTransitiveClosure ast) {
960            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> relation = typeCheck(ast.relation());
961            if (relation.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2) {
962                if (relation.getCommonSupertype().get(0).equals(relation.getCommonSupertype().get(1))) {
963                    return put(relation.getType(), transitiveClosure(relation.getExpr(), ast.reflexive()));
964                }
965            }
966            throw new TypeException(relation + " cannot be transitively closed");
967        }
968
969        private TypedExpr<?> visit(AstConnected ast) {
970            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> relation = typeCheck(ast.relation());
971            TypedExpr<AstSetExpr> nodes = typeCheck(ast.nodes());
972            if (relation.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2) {
973                if (relation.getCommonSupertype().get(0).equals(relation.getCommonSupertype().get(1))) {
974                    return put(BoolType, connected(nodes.getExpr(), relation.getExpr(), ast.directed()));
975                }
976            }
977            throw new TypeException(relation + " cannot be checked for connectivity");
978        }
979    }

981    private static Type[] getTypes(TypedExpr<?>... exprs) {
982        Type[] types = new Type[exprs.length];
983        for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
984            types[i] = exprs[i].getType();
985        }
986        return types;

990        AstBoolExpr[] boolExprs = new AstBoolExpr[exprs.length];
991        for (int i = 0; i < boolExprs.length; i++) {
992            boolExprs[i] = exprs[i].getExpr();

1000            setExprs[i] = exprs[i].getExpr();

1005    private static boolean isAssignable(Type from, Type to) {
1006        for (ProductType left : from) {
1007            if (isAnyAssignable(left, to)) {
1008                return true;
1009            }
1010        }
1011        return false;
1012    }
1013
1014    private static boolean isAssignable(ProductType from, ProductType to) {
1015        AstClafer[] toProduct = to.getProduct();
1016        AstClafer[] fromProduct = from.getProduct();
1017        if (fromProduct.length != toProduct.length) {
1018            return false;
1019        }
1020        for (int i = 0; i < fromProduct.length; i++) {
1021            if (!AstUtil.isAssignable(fromProduct[i], toProduct[i])) {
1022                return false;
1023            }
1024        }
1025        return true;
1026    }
1027
1028    private static boolean isAnyAssignable(Iterable<ProductType> froms, ProductType to) {
1029        for (ProductType from : froms) {
1030            if (isAssignable(from, to)) {
1031                return true;
1032            }
1033        }
1034        return false;
1035    }

1037    private static boolean isAnyAssignable(ProductType from, Iterable<ProductType> tos) {
1038        for (ProductType to : tos) {
1039            if (isAssignable(from, to)) {
1040                return true;
1041            }
1042        }
1043        return false;
1044    }

1046    private static boolean isAnyAssignable(Iterable<ProductType> froms, AstClafer to) {
1047        for (ProductType from : froms) {
1048            if (from.arity() == 1 && AstUtil.isAssignable(from.getProduct()[0], to)) {
1049                return true;
1050            }
1051        }
1052        return false;
1053    }

1066                return true;

1072    private static ProductType getLowestCommonSupertype(ProductType t1, ProductType t2) {
1073        if (t1.arity() != t2.arity()) {
1074            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
1075        }
1076        AstClafer[] product = new AstClafer[t1.arity()];
1077        for (int i = 0; i < product.length; i++) {
1078            product[i] = AstUtil.getLowestCommonSupertype(t1.get(i), t2.get(i));
1079        }
1080        return new ProductType(product);
1081    }
1082
1083    private static boolean isDisjoint(Type t1, Type t2) {
1084        for (ProductType leftType : t1) {
1085            if (isAnyAssignable(leftType, t2.getUnionType())) {
1086                return false;
1087            }
1088        }
1089        for (ProductType rightType : t2) {
1090            if (isAnyAssignable(rightType, t1.getUnionType())) {
1091                return false;
1092            }
1093        }
1094        return true;
1095    }
1096
1097    private static Type intersectionType(Type t1, Type t2) {
1098        Set<ProductType> interType = new HashSet<>();
1099        for (ProductType leftType : t1) {
1100            if (isAnyAssignable(leftType, t2.getUnionType())) {
1101                interType.add(leftType);
1102            }
1103        }
1104        for (ProductType rightType : t2) {
1105            if (isAnyAssignable(rightType, t1.getUnionType())) {
1106                interType.add(rightType);
1107            }
1108        }
1109        return new Type(interType);
1110    }
1111
1112    private static Type unionType(Type t1, Type t2) {
1113        Set<ProductType> unionType = new HashSet<>();
1114        for (ProductType leftType : t1) {
1115            unionType.add(leftType);
1116        }
1117        for (ProductType rightType : t2) {
1118            unionType.add(rightType);
1119        }
1120        return new Type(unionType);
1121    }

1123    private static class TypedExpr<T extends AstExpr> {
1124
1125        private final Type type;
1126        private final T expr;
1127
1128        TypedExpr(Type type, T expr) {
1129            this.type = Check.notNull(type);
1130            this.expr = Check.notNull(expr);
1131        }
1132
1133        public Type getType() {
1134            return type;
1135        }
1136
1137        public Set<ProductType> getUnionType() {
1138            return type.getUnionType();
1139        }
1140
1141        public ProductType getCommonSupertype() {
1142            return type.getCommonSupertype();
1143        }
1144
1145        public T getExpr() {
1146            return expr;
1147        }
1148    }
